note: Sealed manifests/templates, draft pages/navigation and edit operations can duplicate public contact data. Declaration does not bypass immutable release rules; privacy overlay/removal requires a separate owner-authorized implementation.

structures.DraftNavigation: Navigation array permits authored text/links and possible contact copies.
structures.DraftOperation: Persisted edit operation object may contain prior/new personal or contact content.
structures.DraftPageDocument: Draft page object before publication, including possible contact/person copy.
structures.ReleaseManifest: Sealed public release view models including possible copied contact/profile data.
structures.ReleaseTemplateDocument: Sealed template object including possible contact/person copy.
structures.Sha256Digest: Opaque 32-byte cryptographic digest for integrity/request identity/capability verification; never raw token, body or contact data.
structures.ServingBody: Exact public storefront response bytes (UTF-8 JSON) derived from the sealed release view plus SKU codes/labels, prices and availability; may contain published contact/person copy.
structures.SkuOptionValues: Sealed array of {name,value} catalog option code/label pairs of a purchasable SKU; merchant catalog data.
